messages:
elaine: Heads up — opened PR 5123 to add a "Latency shading" example to the Console docs and cross-language tracing hook snippets (TypeScript + Ruby). Also fixed a broken internal link I spotted, but need docs review + a quick migration callout for YAML key changes.

sam: Thanks — jumping in to review. Which pages are affected so I can check anchors?

elaine: dashboard/cost and console/instrumentation. The key changes are: a) an example showing how to attach trace metadata and cost buckets per request; b) a small rename in the YAML sample (costBuckets -> cost_buckets) that will break older embeds; c) TS + Ruby SDK snippets for trace propagation.

priya: Can you paste the snippets here so I can smoke test in the playground?

elaine: Sure — TS first:
```ts
// TypeScript (SDK >=0.8)
import { RedwoodClient } from "@redwood/inference"
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })

await client.attachTrace({
  trace_id: "trace-1234",
  attrs: { route: "/v1/generate", model: "redwood-1" },
  cost: { tokens: 42, gpu_ms: 12 }
})
// then call client.generate(...) with the same trace context
```

and Ruby:
```ruby
# Ruby (gem ~> 0.9)
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])

client.attach_trace(trace_id: 'trace-1234', attrs: { route: '/v1/generate', model: 'redwood-1' }, cost: { tokens: 42, gpu_ms: 12 })
# follow-up generate call reuses trace context
```

kevin: Quick nit — the TS snippet uses attachTrace from SDK v0.8 naming. Our docs already reference v0.9 in other pages. We should either show both signatures or add a version note.

elaine: Good catch. I'll add a short note: "SDK v0.9+ uses attach_trace / attachTrace compatibility shim; see SDK reference."

docs-bot: link-checker: found 1 broken link in console/instrumentation sample -> replaced /internal/old-traces -> /sdk/reference/traces. Please verify.

michael: When this merges, ping @docs-owners and mark the changelog entry as `migration: latency-shading` so we can track adoption in release notes.

priya: I ran both snippets quickly. Ruby needed require path adjusted (gem name vs lib path). Also the YAML example uses `costBuckets` (camelCase) in the PR — I tested older dashboards and they expect `cost_buckets`. We should add a migration callout and a compatibility snippet showing both keys.

elaine: OK I'll add a small migration FAQ block and show both key forms with a note that `cost_buckets` is the canonical server-side field. Targeting merge by EOD. Assigning reviewers: sam, priya, kevin. Any objections to squashing commits?

sam: :thumbsup: Squash is fine. Also please add a tiny CI smoke test that parses the YAML sample so we don't regress link escapes.

kevin: I'll add the CI tweak — basic parse + lint check for the YAML sample in docs-ci.

priya: One more doc-UX thing — the dashboard screenshot in the example needs alt text for accessibility. I'll upload the image to assets and update the path.

elaine: Thanks — I'll push fixes in a minute: version note, migration FAQ, both key variants, alt text, and the updated require line in Ruby. Will also include an explicit callout in the PR description about the link fix so link-check doesn't revert it.

sam: LGTM once the tiny fixes land.

kevin: CI patch submitted; should be green in ~15m.

priya: Verified after fixes — all examples render in playground and the YAML fixture passes parse.

elaine: Excellent — merging after CI. Thanks everyone!
